connector.name: Content Distribution
connector.registryDescription: Publish content to DEV.to, Hashnode, GitHub Discussions, Reddit, Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Medium.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package content-distribution-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the automatelab-tech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
